note: From your results sheet: Pattern Trainer levels 1 and 2 are all green (14 Nov). The E → Am and Dm → E cards were the hardest on the way there. In the Chord Trainer, D vs Dm, E and Em were your slowest chords, and in G minor B♭ and E♭ were much slower than the rest. Today's (16 Nov) rows were test runs, so they're not counted. Next step for kumzitz: the right hand on top of a steady left hand.

items.title: Right-Hand Trainer · 1 · Melody note on each chord
items.why: Your left-hand patterns are green, so add the right hand: one melody note per chord with the left hand holding the open 5th. This is the core kumzitz two-hand skill.

items.title: Kumzitz Jam · Pad under the band
items.why: Your first real try with the band: hold the open 5th in the left hand and the chord in the right hand for the whole bar, changing exactly with the guitar. Start slow, around 60 bpm.

items.title: Pattern Trainer · 5 · Open 5th
items.why: The open 5th (pinky + thumb) is the left hand in the Jam and the Right-Hand Trainer. Make it automatic in A minor first.
